query:
SELECT u.id as user_id, u.email, c.id as conv_id, c.title, c."agentId", c."createdAt", c."updatedAt",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m."conversationId" = c.id) as msg_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c."userId" = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'yunhua.ni@gmail.com'
ORDER BY c."createdAt" DESC
LIMIT 20;
